1.consolidated_definition: Ñame, con tubérculo parecido a la papa, muy harinoso y alimenticio; apreciado por su sabor y fina textura. Dioscoreaceae, Dioscorea trifida.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Yam, with a tuber similar to the potato, very starchy and nutritious; appreciated for its flavor and fine texture. Dioscoreaceae, Dioscorea trifida.
